paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy as a function of epoch for two datasets. The x-axis, labeled "Epoch," is linear, ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at every 5 integer values. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", is linear, ranging from 40% to 100%, with tick labels at every 10% increments. A blue solid line represents the "Train" dataset, starting at 48.7% at epoch 0 and reaching 97.8% at epoch 30, exhibiting fluctuations throughout its course. A green dashed line represents the "Validation" dataset, beginning at 52.1% at epoch 0 and finishing at 83.9% at epoch 30, and also showing fluctuations between these values.
